children: The Czech Republic’s gross domestic product expanded by 0.4% quarter-on-quarter in the second quarter of 2026, accelerating from 0.2% growth in Q1 and matching preliminary estimates, according to the second estimate.

Domestic demand contributed positively to the economy, growing 0.5% from 0.2% a quarter earlier, driven largely by gains in household consumption (0.5% vs 0.3%), while government spending growth remained unchanged at 0.1%.
Meanwhile, gross fixed capital formation moderated to 1.5% from 2.0% in Q1.

On the production side, growth was supported by industry (+0.9%), trade, transport, accommodation and catering (+0.4%), finance and insurance (+2.7%), real estate activities (+0.6%), and construction (+0.3%).
On a yearly basis, the economy grew by 1.9%, slowing from 2.2% in the prior period and edging below preliminary estimates of 2.0%.

title: Czech Republic Q2 GDP Growth Confirmed at 0.4%
